Apricot or apricot blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Graceful Gisela
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 2010).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in before 2010 as 'Graceful Gisela'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot blend or apricot. Soft pink, apricot and cream. None / no fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
